name: mcal_now
description: Get the current date and time — the authoritative, always-fresh clock. Do NOT rely on your own sense of the current date; call this to ground ANY relative date ('today', 'tomorrow', 'next Friday', 'the 15th') and before creating/updating an event from a user-given local time. Pass the target calendar's `tz` (its IANA timezone from mcal_list_calendars) to get local values. Returns: utc, timezone, local (ISO with offset), date (TODAY's local date, YYYY-MM-DD), weekday, tomorrow, yesterday. Prefer the ready-made date/tomorrow/yesterday fields — pass one straight to mcal_list_events `day`, or use `date` to build correct UTC timestamps for writes.

tz.description: IANA timezone to localize into — the target calendar's timezone, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Omit for UTC.
